result.topic_en: Calculations on steady two-dimensional compressible (polytropic) gas flow: a Bernoulli-type relation with the polytropic law, the vorticity–entropy relation, and a reformulation using a stream function leading to a second-order PDE.

methods.what: Jump/Bernoulli relation across a discontinuity for polytropic gas
Vorticity related to entropy gradient across streamlines (Crocco-type relation)
Bernoulli relation in terms of stream function
Divergence-form PDE for the stream function
Quasilinear second-order equation for the stream function after eliminating r
